verdict.rationale: Bugbot has an 'Automatically Learn Rules' toggle. Teams can also persist conventions in `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` and organization-wide rules, and Bugbot reads prior PR comments to build on earlier feedback. However, the auto-learning feature appears only as a one-line settings mention, and one hands-on report shows Bugbot repeating a recommendation the user had already argued against and reverted. Missing for 10: documentation of how rules are learned from past review decisions, evidence that learned memory carries across PRs, independent corroboration that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer builds a persistent memory of my team's conventions and past review decisions and applies it to future PRs

citations.quote: Turn **Automatically Learn Rules** on or off
Create `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files in your repository to give Bugbot project-specific review guidelines.

reads connected PR comments (top-level and inline) to avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback
